title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tek Univers City, Qtu
description_sq:
Shitet Apartement 2+1+2.
Adresa: Aut. Tir-Durres, km 5, Rezidenca "Univers City" prane Qendres Tregtare Univers "QTU".
Sip Bruto 104.42m2.
Ap ofron 2 dhoma gjumi + sallon ndenje + 2 Tualete.
Kati 3 banim (Jug-Lindje).
Ashensor i dedikuar per nje pjese te Apartamenteve.
Ndodhet ne zonen me te mire te Rezidences, ngjitur me Parkun e Rezidences dhe perballe me Shkollen 9-vjecare.
Objekti eshte ne faze ndertimi (Rifinitura), perfundon ne Tetor 2025.
Punimet jane mjaft cilesore dhe me materiale bashkekohore.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne Pallatin me shenje te Kuqe identifikuar ne foto.
Cmimi 115,000 Euro. Ky cmim eshte momental, perpara perfundimit te Ap.
title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Univers City, Qtu
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale. Address: Aut. Tir-Durres, km 5, Residence "Univers City" near Univers Shopping Center "QTU". Gross Sip 104.42m2. Apartment offers 2 bedrooms + living room + 2 toilets. 3rd residential floor (South-East). Elevator dedicated to a part of the Apartments. It is located in the best area of ​​the Residence, next to the Residence Park and in front of the 9-year old School. The object is under construction (Refinishing), it will be completed in October 2025. The works are of high quality and with contemporary materials. The apartment is located in the Palace with the Red sign identified in the photo. Price 115,000 Euro. This price is momentary, before the end of Ap.
